# Python dependencies for the Blockchain Snapshots on AWS consumer toolkit.
#
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Versioning policy: compatible-release pins (`~=`). This allows patch/minor
# updates — so upstream SECURITY fixes reach users without a toolkit release —
# while blocking breaking major-version changes. Deliberately not exact-pinned
# (`==`): this toolkit runs on machines we do not control, and freezing a
# decompressor or AWS SDK at one build would keep users on unpatched versions.
#
# Both packages are permissively licensed and actively maintained.

# Seekable/multi-frame zstd decompression in snapshot-extract.py.
# REQUIRED — the extractor exits if it is missing.
# License: BSD-3-Clause. Parses snapshot bytes, so keep it current.
#
# Lower bound 0.22 (not ~=0.25): Ubuntu 24.04's apt python3-zstandard is 0.22.0,
# which is verified to work (byte-identical extraction) and lets apt satisfy the
# dependency without a PEP 668-blocked system-wide pip install. The lower bound
# still guarantees read_across_frames support; no exact upper pin so security
# patches reach users.
zstandard>=0.22

# AWS SDK — required for the `--s3` read path (ranged GETs), which is what
# download-and-unpack.sh uses wherever FUSE/mount-s3 is unavailable (most
# containers). License: Apache-2.0.
#
# Lower bound 1.20 (not ~=1.42), for the same reason as zstandard above: the
# distro packages must satisfy it so no system-wide pip install is needed
# (Ubuntu 22.04 apt python3-boto3 is 1.20, 24.04 is 1.34). The extractor only
# uses ranged GetObject and adaptive retries, which 1.20 has.
boto3>=1.20
